method: Actual Windows debug executable and WebView2; Playwright CDP frontend input plus real Rust commands/window-state queries. Not physical mouse/monitor or tray hit-testing certification.

results.name: native offline asset startup and independent windows
native assets and IPC work with browser network offline
native caption maximize, restore and minimize
show and hide do not grow the native content size
widget opens without hiding main and shares manual selection
widget pin and opacity use shared durable settings
widget preview timeout cannot reset a newer main-window planning selection
stale cross-window transaction is rejected without lost edit
native preferences UI and durable time format
immediate native WebView reload does not lose the last preference
native sign-in registration can enable and disable with its original state restored
invalid shortcut reports failure and retains the owned shortcut
bare typing shortcut is rejected without replacing the working binding
equivalent shortcut aliases preserve ownership without duplicate registration
a shortcut occupied by another native process is rejected with rollback
